name: LinearAlgebraGame.norm_nonzero_of_nonzero
content:
`norm_nonzero_of_nonzero` is a helper proof that if `v ≠ 0`, then `‖v‖ ≠ 0`. The syntax is
`norm_nonzero_of_nonzero v v_zero`.
